description: This Swift source file provides support functions for camera capture sessions, including preparing photo and movie sessions, warming up sessions, error mapping, and utility methods related to AVCaptureDevice and AVCapturePhotoSettings.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for taking photos, including selecting the camera device and configuring photo output.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for recording movies, configures video and optional audio outputs.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares and warms up a movie session asynchronously, starts the session, warms up capture, and returns the session and output.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Executes an operation with a warmed-up movie session, ensuring the session is started and stopped properly.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps a CameraSessionConfigurationError to a more specific error, such as microphone unavailability or capture failure.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Creates and configures AVCapturePhotoSettings, prioritizing quality and selecting photo codec.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously using a delegate and returns the photo data.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: Performs a short delay after starting the capture session to reduce initial blank frames on some devices.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given AVCaptureDevice.Position.
